# The GPS Change Users Did Not Have to Install

Selective Availability deliberately degraded public GPS signals for national security. In May 2000, at President Bill Clinton’s direction, the US government stopped using it to make civil and commercial GPS more useful worldwide. This was an operational change, not an update users had to install.

In September 2007, the government announced it would procure the future GPS III generation without Selective Availability. That procurement decision was separate from the 2000 operational switch.
